# arabitype

> Catch the Arabic-typography mistakes that break Arabic rendering.

arabitype is a zero-dependency CLI + MCP server (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) that flags the
Arabic-typography errors AI codegen and Latin-default styling produce: letter-spacing / Tailwind
tracking on Arabic (shatters ligatures), tight line-height (crushes tashkeel), tiny sizes,
text-transform: uppercase (meaningless on Arabic), and Latin-only font stacks.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/arabitype .`
- MCP: run `arabitype-mcp` (tools: arabitype_scan, arabitype_check_code)
- AI rules: `arabitype --init-rules` writes ARABIC-TYPE-RULES.md

## Rules for agents
No letter-spacing/tracking on Arabic; line-height ≥ 1.5; body Arabic ≥ 16px; no uppercase on
Arabic; use an Arabic font with a fallback (Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic).

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/arabitype · https://dev.ottospace.co
